labeller_note: I read only batch-h3.json, vocabulary.md, the 13 workflow YAMLs and workflow_registry.py. Results list only result words the prompt actually names (a bare workflow-run phrase such as 'run CONDOR' is labelled with that workflow's main result and a why); open or deferred requests ('something useful', 'what would you suggest', bare method comparisons) get no result and a note. produces respects granularity, regulator kinds and sign: per-sample asks map to LIONESS/BONOBO entries; 'aggregate'/'cohort matrix' asks in a LIONESS run list both the LIONESS entry (which writes the aggregate) and the base entry; aggregate-only asks list base entries only; PUMA/LIONESS-PUMA networks are excluded for TF-only asks. When a PRODUCES entry's own text fixes the input (SAMBAR subtypes from somatic mutations) and the ask uses other data, produces is empty and the matching near-miss is given; otherwise the data binding is recorded as a source link (e.g. a TF network from a mutation matrix, CONDOR communities from counts). Settings are labelled where the words set a listed control, including data declarations that only BONOBO's log_transformed/centered/genes_axis or PANDA's with_header take; GIRAFFE optimizer requests are 'unregistered' since GIRAFFE declares no controls; output paths are not labelled. For two-layer requests the first-named table is layer 1 unless the lambda wording binds a layer. Downstream uses the user states (testing against a clinical variable) are labelled as results with a why saying they may be the user's own step.
